metadata.title: Omnichannel Commerce ERP Data Assets
metadata.description: Catalog, customer, order, supply-chain, finance and platform data of a Logic4 tenant, with GDPR and Dutch fiscal retention governance.

assets.accessScope: Users of the owning Logic4 tenant per their rights

interfaces.name: product master api
interfaces.description: Read/write via the owning brick's API.

governance.retention: Kept for the customer's subscription term; financial records 7 years (Dutch fiscal retention).
